simple.meaning: קָצֶה (qâtseh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “an extremity.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 97 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 8:3. Its contexts include family, city, wilderness, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָצֶה (H7097).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קָצֶה (qâtseh) / H7097 is traced through Genesis 8:3, Genesis 19:4, Genesis 23:9, Genesis 47:2 as a generated source-based concept entry.
